title: Podcast Host Lead Scraper Input
description: Search the podcast directory and extract host leads. Pay per lead.

keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: Topics or niches to find podcasts for (e.g. marketing, true crime, startup, fitness).

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter store country code for the directory. Default US.

maxLeads.title: Max leads
maxLeads.description: Cap total leads scored per run. Kept small by default so a first run is cheap; raise it for a full pull.

maxPerKeyword.title: Max per keyword
maxPerKeyword.description: Cap shows taken from each keyword (iTunes returns up to 200).

minEpisodes.title: Minimum episodes
minEpisodes.description: Drop shows with fewer episodes than this. Zero keeps everything.

activeSinceDays.title: Active in last N days
activeSinceDays.description: Only keep shows with a new episode in this many days. Zero keeps all, active or dormant.

requireEmail.title: Only shows with a host email
requireEmail.description: Skip shows whose RSS feed has no public owner email.
